title: The fibre product of affine schemes is the spectrum of the tensor product
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A,B$ commutative $R$-algebras, and let $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be the morphisms induced by the structure maps [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then there is an isomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}\operatorname{Spec}B\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_RB)$ [def-pc-fibre-product] under which the two projections become $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the ring maps $A\to A\otimes_RB$, $a\mapsto a\otimes1$, and $B\to A\otimes_RB$, $b\mapsto1\otimes b$. In particular the fibre product is affine with ring of global sections $A\otimes_RB$.
